A pair of these will grant Inevitable Balance - 5% Melee Power , 5% Doublestrike, and extra bane damage on sneak attack. So far observed that different variations will grant the same set bonus, although it was also observed that two of the same variations will also show an icon called "Too close to the edge" and gives the description "You are to close the edge of alignment, these weapons work best when they are different from one another."
